name: RGIC-100-35
summary: RGIC-100-35 is an electric rotary gripper that combines servo-controlled gripping with continuous rotation for test-tube opening, sample handling and industrial assembly. The 35 mm stroke and adjustable 40–100 N force per jaw accommodate small workpieces, while integrated drive and control provide position, force and rotation adjustment in one compact unit.
